target.title: feat(macos): open dashboard links in a sidebar browser
target.body:
Closes #102691
Follow-up to #102783

## What Problem This Solves

External links clicked in the macOS dashboard currently leave the app immediately, making it easy to lose context while reading documentation, reports, or other linked pages. Users also have no native link menu for choosing an in-app view, the default browser, or copying the destination.

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds a native WebKit sidebar beside the dashboard with Back, Forward, Reload, domain, default-browser, and Close controls. The app consumes the explicit Control UI bridge from #102783, keeps the sidebar isolated from privileged dashboard scripts, persists its split width, preserves modified-click and existing editor handoff behavior, and limits external app launches to trusted user or Control UI actions.

## User Impact

Plain external HTTP(S) link clicks in the macOS dashboard now open inside a resizable right sidebar. Right-clicking offers **Open in Sidebar**, **Open in Default Browser**, and **Copy Link**; keyboard-activated email and telephone links still hand off to the appropriate system app. Regular browser behavior is unchanged.

## Evidence

- `xcrun swift test --package-path apps/macos --filter DashboardWindowSmokeTests` — 14 tests passed, covering bridge validation, sidebar lifecycle and persistence, navigation policy, synthetic-launch rejection, and trusted editor handoff.
- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kx3m1sakgpxnckjyex283nec`: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/app/native-link-routing.test.ts` — 8 tests passed.
- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kx3m1sakgpxnckjyex283nec`: `CI=true node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/e2e/native-link-routing.e2e.test.ts` — 2 Chromium scenarios passed, including accessible external-app activation and ordinary-browser preservation.
- Signed `dist/OpenClaw.app` built successfully with the Developer ID identity; `codesign --verify --deep --strict` passed.
- Signed-app behavior proof: plain external click opened the sidebar; Back/Forward/Reload/Close worked; divider width survived close/reopen; the three-action link menu rendered; Copy Link returned the exact URL.
- Fresh branch autoreview: clean, no accepted/actionable findings.
